steps: Cook Brown rice according to package directions; set aside.
Dice Zucchini and Bell pepper into small cubes; finely chop Onion and mince Garlic.
Heat Olive oil in a large 30 cm skillet over medium-high heat.
Add Onion and Garlic; cook for 2 minutes, stirring, until translucent.
Add Ground turkey; cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Stir in Dried oregano and Sweet paprika; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add Zucchini, Bell pepper, Crushed tomatoes, and Unsalted chicken broth; stir to combine.
Simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes, until vegetables are tender and sauce thickens.
Serve over Brown rice. Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month.
